scope: Offline production Worker/WebGL with whole UV-free FlightHelmet; not complete React/Three importer certification.

tests.name: Current built release and default-on surface recognition
Real whole helmet generated without source UV
Complete 544-face cap is two intact symmetric sheets, not an arbitrary diagonal slit
Inspector distinguishes surface match from vertex correspondence
tests.detail: 表面对称已验证，使用三角面内的重心对应，不要求左右顶点或三角形一一配对。 表面采样匹配 100.0%，边界/闭合折边匹配 100.0%；原顶点近精确配对（采样） 12.9%（仅诊断，不是门槛）。当前 UV 镜像均方根误差 0.076%，边界 0.035%，最大 0.370%（相对当前岛直径）。 不改变三维网格、不复制半片，也不使用原 UV。

tests.name: Both sides shown and all source cap faces accounted for
Playback does not bind the camera to symmetry plane
Editing recognition setting alone does not change the current result
Repacking retains symmetry contracts and actual inspector audit
Fill preserves reflected surface relations, face ownership, final UV quality
All registered browser and WebGL errors absent
